name: Nanashi no Game: Me
original_name: ナナシ ノ ゲエム 目
source:
Summer chills continue with Nanashi no Game, this is a trial gamers have to overcome within 7 days or they die a gruesome death. Your best friend seemed to think of this as a mere joke, he tried out the game and died soon after. 

To discover the truth behind this cursed game, you set off on this supernatural journey with your girlfriend Ren and the university professor. 

Eerie visuals and music are sure to keep you wide awake and urge you on to clear the game before your time comes. The adventure is in first person, leaving a large number of blind points, giving you a sense of vulnerability. Be on your guard always, you don't know where the menace is coming.
